key_pathways: Fungal cell membrane disruption (not hepatically metabolized)

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Probiotics (during acute therapy)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Nystatin may reduce beneficial bacterial flora; concurrent high-dose probiotics may create conflicting microbial pressures and reduce nystatin efficacy for candida overgrowth
avoid_supplements.action: Separate probiotic dosing by at least 2 hours from nystatin; consider lower probiotic doses during active treatment

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Garlic has mild antifungal properties that may theoretically compete with nystatin's mechanism or mask treatment efficacy assessment
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; use standard culinary amounts if desired

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have overlapping antifungal activity; potential additive effects without established safety data in combination
caution_supplements.action: Use only under clinical guidance; monitor for adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-sugar foods and refined carbohydrates
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess dietary sugar promotes candida growth and may reduce therapeutic efficacy of nystatin treatment
caution_foods.action: Recommend patient reduce sugar intake during treatment course to optimize antifungal outcomes

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol may impair immune function and increase candida proliferation; minimal direct pharmacokinetic interaction but may reduce treatment effectiveness
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol consumption during active nystatin therapy

monitoring_notes: Nystatin is minimally absorbed systemically and has no significant hepatic metabolism, making direct drug-supplement interactions unlikely. Focus monitoring on factors affecting local antifungal efficacy and patient adherence to oral/topical application protocols.
